looksOnlyMode.promptPrefix: Use character look sheet references to preserve each named character's identity and wardrobe. Create one continuous photorealistic live-action shot from the authored scene and action below.
looksOnlyMode.startAuthority: No First Frame is supplied. Compose the opening from the authored visible moment, blocking, camera, location and lighting below.
looksOnlyMode.characterMapping: Image {imageNumber} is the Look Sheet for {roleName}, Look {lookName}. Preserve this character's identity and wardrobe only.
looksOnlyMode.prohibitions: Never reproduce sheet panels, labels, multiple views, neutral poses or sheet backgrounds. Do not duplicate or swap characters. Use the authored scene and performance, not the sheet composition.

phrasing.startFrame: Begin from the approved Storyboard image as the immutable first frame.
phrasing.preserveStartFrame: Preserve every visible identity, garment, prop, spatial relation and motivated light source from that frame.
phrasing.stableCamera: Keep the camera restrained and stable.
phrasing.cameraImperfection: Keep optical and handheld imperfections subtle and compatible with the authored camera direction.

globalProhibitions: Do not change character identity, apparent age, body proportions, hairstyle or approved wardrobe.
Do not invent a second action, a new scene, a new Character, dialogue, prop or camera move.
Avoid synthetic CGI surfaces, plastic skin, beauty filtering and mechanically perfect motion.
